'''Dellin Sorth''' was the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]] of [[Prosperine Entertainment and Distilleries]], and the owner of [[Club Prosperine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]].
